description:
Executes a live HTTP/HTTPS multi-vector compliance audit against any public website URL. Inspects TLS transport, HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options), Set-Cookie headers, client-side tracking scripts, Consent Management Platform (CMP) and Google Consent Mode v2 default 'denied' enforcement (GDPR Art. 5(3)), footer legal policy links (Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy, CCPA Do Not Sell), and—when deep_scan is true—WCAG 2.1 AA DOM accessibility metrics and EU AI Act Article 50 chatbot disclosures.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'audit_site' for an overall 0-100 compliance score, letter grade (A+ to F / FAILED), and cross-framework findings. Use 'scan_cookies' when you only need a categorized cookie/tracker inventory without grading; use 'audit_accessibility' when you need grading against WCAG_2.1_AAA or Section_508; use 'audit_ai_transparency' when you only need EU AI Act Art. 50 & GDPR Art. 22 findings.

Preconditions & side effects: Requires a publicly DNS-resolvable HTTP/HTTPS URL; no authentication or prior 'add_site' registration is required. Read-only operation—performs live outbound HTTP GET inspection and never mutates registered sites.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success', 'audit_id', 'target_url', 'deep_scan', 'compliance_score' (0-100), 'compliance_grade', 'status' ('COMPLETED' | 'FAILED'), 'is_https', 'timestamp', structured 'tests' sub-reports, 'findings', 'recommendations', 'cookie_inventory', and 'error' if unreachable or invalid.

deep_scan.description: When true (default), runs full DOM inspection including WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility checks and EU AI Act chatbot detection. When false, executes a faster baseline check covering TLS, headers, trackers, consent mode, and legal links while skipping WCAG/AI DOM passes.

url.description: Full public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the website to audit.

name: audit_site

compliance_grade.description: Letter grade capped by critical HTTPS or ePrivacy violations; 'FAILED' if unreachable.

compliance_score.description: Calculated numeric compliance score (0 on failure).

cookie_inventory.description: Detailed cookies and tracking scripts discovered during the scan.

items.description: Single detected cookie or client-side tracker entry.

provider.description: Vendor or host domain setting the cookie.

source.description: Discovery mechanism: Set-Cookie response header or HTML script signature.

deep_scan.description: Whether WCAG & AI Act deep DOM passes were executed.

is_https.description: Whether the target URL uses HTTPS.

success.description: True if target responded with HTTP < 400; false on invalid URL, DNS/network failure, or HTTP >= 400.

tests.description: Structured compliance check sub-reports across connectivity, TLS, consent, headers, legal links, WCAG, and EU AI Act.

detected_scripts.description: List of third-party tracking scripts identified in the HTML DOM.

items.description: Detected third-party script or vendor label.

detected_trackers_count.description: Total cookies and tracking scripts observed on initial load.

eu_ai_act.description: EU AI Act Article 50 chatbot and disclosure check summary (skipped when deep_scan is false).

ai_chatbots_detected.description: AI conversational widgets discovered on the page.

items.description: Detected AI chat widget provider name.

synthetic_media_disclosures.description: Whether explicit AI/synthetic interaction disclosure copy was found.

legal_disclosures.description: Presence check for required statutory policy links in the HTML DOM.

ccpa_do_not_sell.description: California 'Do Not Sell or Share' / 'Your Privacy Choices' link check.

privacy_policy.description: Privacy Policy link presence (GDPR Art. 13/14 & CCPA).

prior_consent_enforcement.description: GDPR Art. 5(3) pre-consent tracker gating evaluation.

security_headers.description: Evaluation of critical HTTP security response headers.

ssl_tls_security.description: Whether the target enforces HTTPS transport security.

wcag_accessibility.description: WCAG 2.1 AA DOM accessibility pass summary (skipped when deep_scan is false).

landmarks_detected.description: Semantic landmarks found in the document.

items.description: HTML5 or ARIA landmark tag/role name.

missing_alt_images.description: Count of elements missing non-empty alt attributes.

website_reachable.description: Whether the target responded with HTTP < 400.

title: Multi-Vector Website Compliance Audit
